QuestInfo.name: Awakening
QuestInfo.0: Why are the Elves still cursed? The Curse of the Black Mage should have worn off by now! Yet you're the only one who's woken up. You need to think about this very carefully...
QuestInfo.1: Nothing is making any sense. If the curse is still around, why did you wake up? And all by yourself? Maybe it's time you #bleave #m101050000# and see what's happening in Maple World.#k
QuestInfo.2: Just as you were about to leave Elluel, you realized that you're only Lv. 10! Did the Curse of the Black Mage do that to you? And what are you going to do? You can't survive the vicious slimes outside in this state!

0.0: I don't understand... Why am I the only one who woke up? Is the curse still here? Why are the others still trapped in the ice?
0.1: If the curse is still here, then why did I wake up? And this feeling... Is the Black Mage's seal getting weaker?
0.2: This is no time for random guessing, Mercedes! I need to get out of #b#m101050000# and see what's happening for myself.#k

yes.0: We need help from the outside. The Elves have many friends, after all. Don't worry, my people. I'll be back soon!

no.0: Am I the only one who woke up? Perhaps someone else broke free of the curse...

default.0: Where was the #bexit#k again? It...was on the left side of town, wasn't it? Ugh, don't tell me the curse messed up my memory...
